import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sin(p[5]*t); c = np.cos(p[5]*t)
    return p[0]*t + p[1]*P*np.log(P) + p[2]*P + (p[3] + p[4]*s + p[6]*c + p[7]*t)/P

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    w = 0.4173
    s = np.sin(w*t); c = np.cos(w*t)
    h = p[2] + p[3]*s + p[4]*c + p[5]*t + p[6]*t*s + p[7]*t*c + p[8]*t*t + p[9]*np.log(t)
    return p[0]*t + p[1]*P*np.log(P) + h/P
